title: North Korea says tested AI-assisted torpedo system
description: North Korea has tested a newly developed precision-guided torpedo system that incorporates artificial intelligence for targeting. This announcement follows a series of missile tests and a recent increase of tensions along the border with South Korea. Analysts suggest that North Korea could be improving its weapons technology with assistance from external sources. The ongoing arms race has encouraged both North and South Korea to advance their military capabilities.

title: North Korea says it tested new torpedo system with AI capabilities
description: North Korea says it has tested a new torpedo system that uses artificial intelligence for target detection and guidance. North Korean state media said Friday the weapon was a “super-speed precisely guided” torpedo system named “Zam-2.0.” It didn't explain what was meant by artificial intelligence. South Korea’s military, which often accuses the North of exaggerating its military technologies, did not immediately comment on KCNA’s report. North Korea has been ramping up weapons demonstrations in recent weeks, including conducting its first underwater-launched missile tests in nearly three years, as leader Kim Jong Un shifts his focus to naval capabilities after years of ballistic missile development.
